subject: Restart orchestrator daemon
description:
Implement two features in the Zonoid orchestrator at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid: ## Feature 1: Progress heartbeat via classify.sh The classifier (hooks/classify.sh) already injects instructions into the main agent on every UserPromptSubmit. Add a heartbeat instruction: 1. In daemon.js: add `report_interval_seconds` to the overlay config defaults (default: 300). The existing `POST /config` endpoint already merges arbitrary fields — no new route needed. Add a `GET /config` route (or expose the existing config via the dashboard's data endpoint) so hooks can read it. 2. In classify.sh: after building the existing context output, read `report_interval_seconds` from `GET localhost:$PORT/config`. Adjust it based on the routing decision already computed: - decision=workflow or many in-flight tasks → multiply by 0.67 (tighten), floor at 60s - decision=solo/simple → multiply by 1.33 (relax) - Clamp to [60, 3600] Add this line to the additionalContext output: `"If tasks are in flight, use ScheduleWakeup({delaySeconds: X, reason: 'progress heartbeat', prompt: 'Report progress on in-flight orchestrator tasks: call show_dashboard, summarize what completed and what is still running, then reschedule the next heartbeat.'}) after responding."` 3. In public/graph.html settings popup (around line 260-272): add a dropdown for the heartbeat interval before the Save button: ```html
Progress heartbeat
How often the main agent auto-reports in-flight task progress
``` Wire it into toggleSettingsPopup (load saved value into dropdown) and saveSettings (save to localStorage + POST /config {report_interval_seconds: value}). ## Feature 2: Completion notice via Stop hook When a subagent finishes and the main agent responds, the Stop hook should surface what just completed. 1. In daemon.js: add a `/completed-since` endpoint. It accepts `?session=SID&since=TIMESTAMP` and returns tasks that moved to done/failed since that timestamp, with their labels and brief summaries. Also add `/completed-since/ack` (POST) that records the last-acked timestamp per session. 2. Create hooks/stop-report.sh: fires on the Stop hook event. Reads last-ack timestamp for this session from daemon, calls `/completed-since`, if any tasks completed emits additionalContext: `"[Orchestrator] Tasks completed since your last response: "`. 3. Wire stop-report.sh into .claude/settings.json Stop hook. ## Constraints - Call start_task on the task assigned to you BEFORE editing any files (gate requirement) - The daemon source is at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js - Hooks live at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/hooks/ but are symlinked from /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/hooks/ — edit the zonoid/hooks/ originals - settings.json is at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/.claude/settings.json - Match existing code style exactly - Do not restart the daemon (disruptive — user will do it) --- From Learner queue: batch-process all candidates with cursor, no upfront cap: Build a queue-based multi-step processing mode for /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/scripts/onboard-learn.js, modeled on the judge cursor pattern. Problem: the current --max-candidates cap is architecturally wrong — on large repos (cosma-ai-studio: 2457 candidates), the cap destroys coverage (150 kept only 20 notes, kb_earned 13%). Fix: (1) New subcommand/flag: onboard-learn.js --enqueue --out reads all mined notes from --in and writes a queue file (/onboard-queue.json: {pending:[...all candidates...], kept:[], rejected:[], cursor:0, total:N}). (2) onboard-learn.js --drain --batch 50 --out : reads queue, processes the next --batch candidates through the existing LLM keep/reject logic, updates kept/rejected/cursor in place, exits. Re-runnable: safe to call repeatedly until cursor==total. (3) onboard-learn.js --inject --confirm can already work from onboard-notes.json; after drain completes write final onboard-notes.json from queue.kept as before. (4) Add --queue-status flag: prints {total, processed:cursor, kept:len(kept), remaining:total-cursor, done:cursor==total}. (5) Remove --max-candidates or keep it as a hard emergency cap only (default: none). Follow orch-gate: write to /tmp, cp into place. Branch orch/attempt/learner-queue off main in /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator, add tests (test/learner-queue.test.js style), run full suite + smoke.sh green, then merge to main. Do NOT restart the daemon. Summary of what you built goes to complete_task on the graph task key provided in your context — use the HTTP API (POST http://localhost:8787/overlay/status with workspace=/Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude) since MCP workspace resolution may be stale until daemon restart. --- From Manually apply gated-DAG patch to daemon.js: Apply the gated-DAG patch to /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js. In the gated /search block (around line 1547), replace the existing block with one that: (1) collects gatedDagNotes from task_key context_deps before the rate-limit check, (2) excludes those keys from noteCands, (3) returns gatedDagNotes on rate-limited or abstain, (4) returns [...gatedDagNotes, ragNote] on inject. The exact replacement code is in the task summary of followup/apply-gated-dag-patch-to-daemon-js-searc-dav2. After applying, restart the daemon: pkill -f 'node /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js' && node /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js & Then commit the change. --- From Restart daemon to activate /harness/overhead endpoint: The daemon needs a restart to pick up two code changes merged to main: (1) lib/human-input.js now exports harnessOverheadTokens(); (2) daemon.js has a new GET /harness/overhead route. Run: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && node daemon.js (or however the daemon is normally restarted — check package.json scripts or the existing restart pattern). Verify the endpoint responds: curl http://localhost:8787/harness/overhead --- From Restart daemon to activate /session-info endpoint: The daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js was updated to add a /session-info?session=SID endpoint (returns {session, is_subagent}). The gate scripts at /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/hooks/orch-gate.sh and orch-gate-bash.sh now query this endpoint. Restart the daemon process (kill PID and re-run `node daemon.js` from /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid) so the new endpoint is live. Verify with: curl -s 'localhost:8787/session-info?session=test-123' — should return {"session":"test-123","is_subagent":false}. --- From Restart daemon to activate system_reminder_est endpoint changes: daemon.js was updated (GET /harness/overhead now computes system_reminder_est residual). The running daemon (PID 99965, /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/daemon.js) needs a restart to pick up the changes. Kill the process and let launchd/the normal start mechanism restart it, or run: kill 99965 && cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && node daemon.js & --- From Restart daemon to activate unwired quarantine: Restart the orchestrator daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid (kill existing PID, node daemon.js in background, verify /health and that /mark-root endpoint exists). This activates the unwired-task quarantine feature. --- From Restart daemon to apply taskTranscript fix: The daemon.js fix to attribute inline main-agent work on claimed tasks to the mainTranscript (instead of counting it as trapped) requires a daemon restart to take effect. Restart the orchestrator daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid so the updated taskTranscript function is loaded. After restart, verify with: curl -s http://localhost:8787/costflow | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'); const j=JSON.parse(d); console.log('trapped:', j.totals.trapped, 'productive:', j.totals.productive);" --- From Restart daemon to load wires_to changes: Restart the orchestrator daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid to pick up the wires_to changes in lib/mcp-core.js and daemon.js. Run: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && node daemon.js (or whatever the restart procedure is — check package.json scripts). Verify the daemon starts cleanly and the record_decision MCP tool now includes wires_to in its schema. --- From Restart orchestrator daemon to pick up verdict enforcement: The orchestrator daemon at http://localhost:8787 (source /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/daemon.js) has merged-but-not-loaded changes adding structured verdicts/stale-hold enforcement. Restart the daemon process and verify GET /state still serves the graph. --- From Restart orchestrator daemon to serve /costflow: The orchestrator daemon source at /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator now includes a GET /costflow endpoint, merged-flag persistence on /git/merge, and a dashboard cost popup (merged to main at commit 3709287). The running daemon on http://localhost:8787 still serves the old code (GET /costflow returns 404). Restart the daemon process so the new code is live: find the running process (lsof -ti tcp:8787), kill it, and relaunch `node /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/daemon.js` the same way it is normally supervised (check for a launchd plist or how it was last started; it persists its workspace in its data dir so it resumes serving /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude). Then stamp via lib/overlay.js setGit(overlay, key, {merged:true, merge_sha, merged_at, backfilled:true}) + save, and POST /workspace {path:'/Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude'} to the live daemon on http://localhost:8787 so it reloads the overlay (verify the stamps survive a re-read; the daemon's own saves can clobber a racing write - bin/backfill-merged.js shows the retry/verify pattern). sources.prompt: The note dup guard (DUP_THRESHOLD=0.55 cosine on title vecs) was merged into routes/overlay.js. Restart the daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid to activate it. Run: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && node daemon.js (or use the existing restart script/hook). sources.title: Restart daemon to activate t.assignee fix in active-claim
sources.prompt: Restart the orchestrator daemon at ~/.claude/orchestrator to pick up the fix in orch/attempt/fix-active-claim-35 (routes/session.js: t.agent_id → t.assignee in /active-claim handler).
